cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Data Visualization Engineer to join our team.

Ability to deliver both high-level explanations of complex problems while also able to deep dive into complex problems

Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Highly organized and systematic, with superb attention to detail
Able to complete tasks with a high degree of accuracy and an eye toward process improvement
Creative problem solver, ability to handle multiple projects, and strong work ethic

Advanced analytics experience - classification/predictive modeling, optimization models, forecasting
Experience with Python for data engineering or advanced data analysis projects/use cases
Healthcare domain knowledge and experience

Persistent and resilient, comfortable in a highly collaborative environment

With the advent of genomic sequencing, more data is available than ever before, but providers often lack the infrastructure or expertise to make sense of it. We are working to connect an entire ecosystem to redefine how genomic data is used in clinical settings.
cond_0342.responsibilities: Work with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and coordinate the design, development, and delivery of advanced analytics dashboards, reporting, and business intelligence tools into production. Partner with technical and product teams to design and build data views that support advanced analytical reporting, self-service data analysis, and exploration, using multiple data and visualization technologies. Coordinate with internal teams to identify and align changes to internal systems in support of future data analysis needs and requirements. Work alongside colleagues to facilitate data governance initiatives and help ensure data integrity across distributed systems. Contribute to solving new and interesting problems together.
cond_0342.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Operations Research, Marketing or similar
3+ Years of experience developing data sets for analysis use cases
3+ Years of experience with direct stakeholder management and ownership of the full lifecycle of analytics/data projects and presenting analysis results to stakeholders
3+ Years of report development and data visualization experience with BI tools (Looker, Tableau, etc.)
Ability to deliver both high-level explanations of complex problems while also able to deep dive into complex problems
Advanced SQL skills for querying and analysis of large, complex datasets
Must work well in a team environment and be able to partner with both business and technical team members and translate technical language to the non-technical need
Creative problem solver, ability to handle multiple projects, and strong work ethic needed
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Highly organized and systematic, with superb attention to detail
Able to complete tasks with a high degree of accuracy and an eye toward process improvement
Persistent and resilient person who thrives in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment
Advanced analytics experience - classification/predictive modeling, optimization models, forecasting
Experience with Python for data engineering or advanced data analysis projects/use cases
Healthcare domain knowledge and experience
Expert knowledge of database/data modeling concepts, SQL skills, proficiency in query performance tuning, and desire to share knowledge with others
Experience with Snowflake DB or Looker Admin
